🧠 Crypto News Brief: Risk-on euphoria: Bitcoin smashed a six-week range to top $71K as a record $3B short squeeze and Washington's coordinated crypto embrace ignited the tape — though a fresh DeFi exploit kept the reminder of risk close. 🚀 Bitcoin Tops $71K as Trump Presses Congress on the CLARITY Act Crypto ripped higher into Thursday, with Bitcoin surging roughly 8% toward $70K and Ethereum jumping about 18% past $2,200, lifting total market cap near $2.45 trillion. The move accelerated after President Trump used a White House event to urge Congress to pass a "fair version" of the CLARITY Act and floated deeper federal support for digital assets. Read full story → 💥 Record $3B Short Squeeze — Largest Since 2021 Six weeks of tight consolidation snapped violently, triggering about $3 billion in short liquidations over 24 hours — the biggest short wipeout in records dating to 2021, with over $1 billion cleared in a single hour. A US Treasury move to double long-dated buybacks to $4B pulled yields lower and lit the fuse, forcing bearish bets to buy back into thin supply. More details → 🏦 Bitcoin ETFs Haul $517M — Biggest Day in Three Months US spot Bitcoin ETFs pulled in $517.2 million on Aug. 19, their strongest single session since early May, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $284.7 million. The wave of institutional buying landed as Bitcoin broke above $69K for the first time in two months, underscoring that regulated vehicles remain the preferred on-ramp. Read more → ⚡ Ethereum Rockets 18%, Reclaims $2,200 Ethereum outpaced Bitcoin with a near-18% surge, reclaiming the $2,200 level as spot ETH ETFs added $189.1 million in a single day — BlackRock's ETHA alone accounting for $122.1 million. The rebound reasserted ETH's short-term leadership after weeks of muted price action. See details → 🤝 Trump Gathers Crypto's Who's-Who at the White House President Trump hosted executives from Coinbase, Ripple, Kraken, Robinhood, Gemini and Intercontinental Exchange, alongside SEC Chair Paul Atkins, declaring the administration had "ended the war on crypto." The closed-door gathering, a day after regulators unveiled fresh token-issuance guidance, framed clear US rules as essential to keeping builders on American soil. 77664.subject: Online check-in for a smooth take-off. ATTENTION! Don’t forget – it opens 24 hours before departure. (Y9SB5U)
77664.body:
Hello, Oleh Novosadov!

Your adventure is just around the corner – you’ll soon be boarding your Ryanair flight! There’s just one small step left to ensure a smooth start: online check-in.

It’s easy – do it via the Ryanair app. This way, you avoid unnecessary fees at the airport..

How to do it? Here’s a quick guide:

You will need:
- Booking code: Y9SB5U
- Booking email: novosadov@boarding.sk (it may differ from your personal email address)

If you’re using the Ryanair mobile app, you can check in directly there – it’s fast, convenient and eco-friendly.

When is check-in available?
- From 24 to 2 hours before departure
- If you’ve purchased seats, you can check in as early as 60 days before your flight

Download your boarding passes.

Save them in the app – you’ll need them when going through airport security. Before your trip, make sure your BOARDING PASSES (tickets) are in ELECTRONIC FORM. Download them to your phone.

You’ll find a full step-by-step guide with screenshots in our manual for checking in online via the Ryanair app.

ATTENTION! If you leave the check-in until the airport, it may cost you up to €55.

That’s a lot of money you could use for your next Pelikan adventure instead! Check our calendar of promotional flights and start planning your next trip right now!
